text:
Evan: quick thread — saw a weird routing on two SM98 boxes where the runtime picked the generic GEMM kernel for seqlen=64, latency 2.4x higher than our alt path.
Maria: can you paste the profiler snippet?
Evan: here's the trace (cropped):
```
Kernel chosen: generic_gemm_v1
seqlen: 64
sm: 98
time: 8.2ms
alt_kernel: prefetch_fused_gemm_v2 -> 3.4ms
flags: tensor_cores=1, bf16=1, fp8=UNDECIDED
```
Dinesh: hmm, looks like our capability inference left fp8 as UNDECIDED. Are those nodes reporting the driver/runtime attributes correctly?
Evan: NVML shows sm=98 and tensor cores present, but driver is 530.41 on the slow nodes. Nightly perf-bot microbench had mixed results.
perf-bot: nightly microbench: sm98 pool -> 12/16 nodes report fp8_hw=1, 4 nodes (driver 530.x) report fp8_hw=0 in the probe.
Maria: our mapping currently uses a driver-version table (>=535 -> fp8_ok) which is brittle. Newer cards can opt into fp8 via runtime flags, so table-based logic fails.
Dinesh: proposal: implement a lightweight runtime probe that runs a tiny kernel to confirm fp8+tensor ops availability per device. Run async at node startup, cache in /var/lib/redwood/device-cap.json, and fall back to microbench when uncertain.
Jamai: microbenching on startup will add ~40ms for the first worker. If it's async + cached that's fine. Ops prefers a persisted cache to avoid rolling restarts thrashing.
Evan: alternative: check cublasGetVersion + cudaDeviceGetAttribute flags and a tiny inline kernel that queries __nvvm_reflect or similar. That should be sub-ms and safer than a full microbench.
Maria: I'll add unit tests for capability inference (simulate driver version + nvml responses) so we don't regress the mapping again.
Dinesh: I'll land the async probe + cache PR. Will emit a metric "device.capability.uncertain" and increment when we route to generic_gemm fallback.
Jamai: ops action: I'll schedule driver rollout for the 4 nodes still at 530.x and add a runbook entry for verifying device-cap cache after upgrades.
Evan: action list: Dinesh -> async probe + metrics PR; Maria -> unit tests for mapping; Jamai -> ops driver bump & runbook. I'll create issues and tag owners.
perf-bot: created perf issue #4821: "sm98: fp8 capability mismatch -> generic kernel routing" (summary attached).
Maria: also let's add a short log line when fallback kernel is chosen: "runtime:cap_infer=fallback reason=fp8_unknown node_id=..." so we can correlate in traces.
Evan: agreed. That'll make triage easier. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jamai: noted, will follow up after weekend rollout.
